task.description: Implement section 9 of the now-gate-approved lib/letflow/design/iss0732-promotion-apply-assertion-gate.md (the OQ-2 amendment) on top of your own earlier commit 4efff094. This closes a follow-up gap found by SECURITY-REVIEWER: verify_rehearsed/2 (which you already added) must ALSO reject an in-progress (status: :running) assertion run, not just an assertions_failed > 0 one -- the amendment's chosen fix is `status not in [:running]`, checked in ADDITION to (never instead of) the existing assertions_failed == 0 check, plus a new, distinct :assertion_run_in_progress error reason mapped to its own 409 in promotions.ex, per the design's exact ordering (status check as new step 3, assertions_failed check renumbered to step 4). Do not weaken or remove anything from your earlier commit -- this is additive. Update test/letflow/routers/req077_promotion_pipeline_test.exs's insert_passing_assertion_run!/3 helper if needed to make sure it inserts a :passed (not :running) row so the 3 existing happy-path fixtures you already fixed keep passing under the new stricter check -- and add new regression coverage for the in-progress-rehearsal rejection path itself (a review whose latest assertion run is status: :running gets rejected with :assertion_run_in_progress, not silently accepted). Run mix compile --warnings-as-errors and the targeted test files again, quote real output.
acceptance_criteria: A review whose latest assertion run has status: :running is rejected by apply_review/4 with the new :assertion_run_in_progress reason, even if assertions_failed == 0 on that row
A review whose latest assertion run has status: :teardown_failed and assertions_failed == 0 is STILL accepted (this must not regress -- proves the fix did not become status == :passed-only)
The 3 existing happy-path fixtures (insert_passing_assertion_run!/3 call sites) still pass
Targeted test file(s) output quoted verbatim in result.summary, 0 failures

result.summary:
Implemented design §9 (OQ-2 amendment) additively on top of commit 4efff094. verify_rehearsed/2 (lib/letflow/definitions/promotion.ex) gained a new step 3 -- `assertion_run.status not in [:running]` -- run after the existing digest-match check and strictly before the existing (renumbered step 4) `assertions_failed == 0` check, exactly per §9.2's ordering. On status == :running it returns {:error, :assertion_run_in_progress}, a new plain-atom member added to apply_review_error() (not a tuple, per INV-NEW-2). The existing assertions_failed == 0 check, the :assertion_run_missing / :assertion_run_digest_mismatch / :assertion_run_failed branches, and the digest constant-time comparison are all untouched. lib/letflow/routers/promotions.ex render_apply/2 gained one new clause: {:error, :assertion_run_in_progress} -> Response.conflict/2, 409, detail 'the most recent assertion run for this review has not finished yet; wait for it to complete or re-run assertions before applying' -- same shape/rationale as the three existing new 409 clauses (§5.2/§9.5), not folded into invalid_transition_response/1. test/letflow/routers/req077_promotion_pipeline_test.exs: insert_passing_assertion_run!/3 already inserted status: :passed (no change needed there -- it was already correct from commit 4efff094, so the 3 existing happy-path fixtures needed no edits). Added a new describe block 'ISS-0732 §9 amendment: verify_rehearsed/2 rejects an in-progress rehearsal' with a new insert_assertion_run!/4 helper (parameterised status) and two new tests: (1) a status: :running matching-digest run -> apply_promotion returns 409 with detail matching 'has not finished yet', review stays :approved, target definition is not promoted (nothing written, INV-NEW-3); (2) a status: :teardown_failed, assertions_failed == 0 run -> apply_promotion still returns 200/applied, proving the fix is an ADDITIONAL exclusion of :running only, not a regression to status == :passed-only (guards against candidate (A) from §9.1, which was explicitly rejected).

`mix compile --warnings-as-errors` (full project): clean, no output beyond 'Compiling 4 files (.ex)', 0 warnings, 0 errors.

Targeted suite (`mix test test/letflow/definitions/promotion_test.exs test/letflow/routers/promotions_test.exs test/letflow/routers/req077_promotion_pipeline_test.exs`), run twice (once during initial verification, once for final quoted evidence): both runs ended `Finished in ~82-98 seconds (0.00s async, ...s sync)` / `Result: 56 passed` -- 0 failures both times (56 = the prior 54 plus the 2 new regression tests added here). No skips, no excludes hit.
result.next_action: Route to SECURITY-REVIEWER (tenant-data path: apply_review/4 gates a promotion-apply mutation) then REVIEWER, per WF-03 Step 3's gate sequence -- same gates the original commit 4efff094 already needed, now re-run against this additive amendment.
